title: DISASTER RECOVERY AND MULTI-REGION
subtitle: Plan for losing a region, or your data, before it happens.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

blocks.text: RPO: how much data you can lose. RTO: how long you can be down. Agree them per system.
Backup & restore → pilot light → warm standby → active-active: each rung costs more and recovers faster.

items: Another region and account; immutable storage
Test restores: the measured time is your real RTO
Async cross-region replication: RPO not quite 0
Plan the failback; run game days

blocks.text: "The ledger has RPO near zero and RTO of 15 minutes: sync replicas across zones, a warm standby region, and point-in-time backups in a separate account. Browsing and search run active-active because they are rebuildable."
